purpose: Frozen blind confirmatory panel for fixed sparse source-age caps; no intervention tuning was performed on these tasks.
source_visibility: The eight task identities were recorded before method results and were not exposed to intervention tuning.

policy.query: policy.predict_action_chunk followed by native policy and environment postprocessors

tasks.task_name: pick up the cream cheese and place it in the basket
pick up the ketchup and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl on the cookie box and place it on the plate
pick up the black bowl on the stove and place it on the plate
open the middle drawer of the cabinet
open the top drawer and put the bowl inside
put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket
put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it

method_semantics.fresh_h1: Query at physical steps 0,1,2,... and execute the newest same-target candidate, equivalent to fresh action execution.
method_semantics.fixed_h8: Query at physical steps 0,8,16,... and execute the newest same-target candidate from the latest sparse query record on intervening steps.
method_semantics.fixed_h16: Query at physical steps 0,16,32,... and execute the newest same-target candidate from the latest sparse query record on intervening steps.
method_semantics.native_h100: Query at physical steps 0,100,200,... and execute the newest same-target candidate from the latest sparse query record on intervening steps; no temporal aggregation.

analysis.paired_unit: same task, init_state_id, and environment seed across methods
analysis.pooled_reducer: sum episode successes over all 8 tasks; pooled query rate = sum queries / sum environment steps
